name: Rebuild Model Site on Release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  rebuild-model-site:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:

        run: |
          curl -X POST "${{ secrets.MODEL_SITE_DEPLOY_HOOK }}"

          MODEL_SITE_DEPLOY_HOOK: ${{ secrets.MODEL_SITE_DEPLOY_HOOK }}
